thread:
emma: incident bot fired — p99 and streaming tail spike in eu-west-1 for inference-path, customer reports stalls in chat streaming :rotating_light:
ops-bot: INCIDENT STARTED 4999993210 — Severity: sev2 — symptoms: streaming tail > 2s p95, p99 > 6s, error rate up ~0.8%
raj: oncall here, picking up. seeing a correlated rise in control-plane configfetch latencies to aurora-tokenstore (read replica). 
kate_sre: confirmed. logs show repeated `timeout awaiting response` from aurora-auth at ~04:12-04:18 UTC. sample log:
```
[04:13:02] service=controlplane caller=config_fetch.go:142 err=\"rpc timeout\" duration=2.1s target=aurora-tokenstore-rw
[04:13:03] service=inference-gateway caller=streaming.go:88 warn=\"stream stall\" session=abc123 wait=1.4s
```
alex_prod: customer-facing note: a handful of high-throughput customers in eu-west-1 report >5s streaming starts. not a full outage but visible. Lia, can we scope impact?
lia_pm: I can pull account list — looks like 7 tenants with heavy streaming. no billing impact yet but UX degraded.
emma: probable root candidate = aurora tokenstore read-replica experiencing CPU steal and connection queueing after a rollout yesterday. configfetch falls back to auth on path and causes retry storms.
raj: check metrics: `aurora_cpu`, `conn_queue`, `auth_5xx`. 
ops-bot: metric alert: aurora-tokenstore-rw cpu 92% -> conn_queue 350 -> pg_pool_waits increasing.
kate_sre: quick mitigations: 1) pin inference controlplane to fallback token-cache in-memory for 1 minute; 2) scale aurora read-replica; 3) enable soft rate-limit on configfetch to reduce thundering herd. I'm going to push 1 and 3 now.
emma: do it. how do we pin to fallback cache? raj: curl to controlplane feature route with admin key:
```
curl -X POST "https://controlplane.internal/admin/feature_override" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  -d '{"feature":"token_cache_fallback","value":true,"ttl_secs":60}'
```
raj: applied override. logs show `token_cache_fallback enabled` at 04:14:10.
alex_prod: will alert CS to delay any customer calls — sending note: "We're seeing transient streaming slowness in eu-west-1, mitigation in progress." :phone:
lia_pm: copying affected tenant IDs to CS.
kate_sre: scaling aurora-replica now (requested +2 nodes). submitting: `./infra scale-db --cluster aurora-tokenstore --replicas +2`
ops-bot: infra job queued 14982, estimate 90s to healthy.
emma: also set temporary backoff on configfetch in gateway: `CONFIG_FETCH_RETRY_BASE=200ms MAX=500ms` to reduce retries spamming aurora. raj can you roll that?
raj: pushed new env via canary to 10% pods in eu-west-1. logs show configfetch lat dropped from ~800ms to ~120ms on canary.
kate_sre: monitoring streaming p99 and tail. initial drop in p99 at canary nodes.
ops-bot: infra job 14982 completed, replicas healthy at 04:15:45. aurora_cpu down to 60%. conn_queue -> 30.
emma: good. keep fallback cache active for 5m while things stabilize.
raj: increasing fallback ttl to 300s via admin endpoint.
alex_prod: CS updated: mitigation applied, we expect reduced stalls within 2-5 minutes. customers notified.
lia_pm: Product note — check if recent rollout touched tokenstore client lib. any deploys last 24h?
emma: yes, deploy 2026-03-14T22:03 changed connection pooling defaults. that likely reduced pool size and exposed pressure.
kate_sre: action items: 1) revert or patch client pooling defaults in next deploy (owner: eng-runtime, raj) 2) add readiness gating for aurora during future rollouts (owner: eng-infra, emma) 3) extend token cache fallback and add metric-level automated triggers (owner: eng-platform, kate_sre)
raj: quick patch: revert pooling change in a hotfix branch, will coordinate a canary and rollout if green.
ops-bot: incident update — p99 streaming eu-west-1 returned to baseline 04:17:30, error rate normalized. continuing observation.
alex_prod: customer support: flagged top 7 tenants with status updates. one tenant had 6 user sessions affected for ~2-3 minutes each, we should offer SLA credit if they escalate.
lia_pm: logging followup: capture trace IDs for affected streams and run evals to check output correctness vs degradation window.
kate_sre: digging into logs — found retry storm pattern: configfetch failure -> client retries 4x quickly -> each retry results in KV cache miss -> repeated auth calls. will add circuit breaker to client code.
emma: updating status page: "Partial performance degradation in eu-west-1 affecting streaming starts. Mitigation applied; monitoring."
raj: closing loop: hotfix branch built, canary shows no regression in perf. scheduling full rollout in 15m with rollback window.
ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED 4999993245 — Reason: aurora read-replica pressure after pooling change; mitigations (cache fallback, DB scaling, configfetch backoff) restored SLOs.
kate_sre: retrospective notes to add: pre-deploy check for DB pool delta, automated circuit-breaker on configfetch, graceful degrade to cache by default on high DB lat.
lia_pm: assigning follow-ups in tracker: INF-4312 (patch pooling), INF-4313 (circuit breaker), INF-4314 (auto-trigger fallback). owners set.
emma: thanks team. continuing watch for 1hr. :thumbsup:
